posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to get listed on software review sites like G2, Capterra, etc.

This might be the most obvious of the bunch, but those pages rank in search and AI cites them when people ask for software recommendations.

Here is how:

1. Create or claim your SaaS pages on G2, Capterra, GetApp, Trustpilot, SourceForge and Software Advice. These are must-haves.
2. Fill them out with a clear description, the right categories, screenshots, pricing and your website.
3. Get reviews ASAP. Ask your customers, follow up after a good support conversation and send them a direct review link. Ask for their honest experience.
4. Keep the pages updated and keep collecting reviews as your customer base grows.

A few notes:

G2, Capterra, GetApp and Software Advice now share new reviews across their network. A new review counts toward your rating and review count on all four sites where you are listed, even though the full text appears on one. That gives you more coverage from the same effort.

If you have no reviews, start asking your customers today. Don't leave those pages empty and forget about them. Don't sleep on reviews.
posts.author: Taras
posts.notes: 在 G2、Capterra、GetApp、Trustpilot、SourceForge、Software Advice 创建或认领 SaaS 页面、填写描述分类截图定价网站、收集评价，得到搜索和 AI 推荐中的外链。
